prompt.en: Turn this solution into a clear, presentation-ready visual showing the key business processes, system components, data flows, stakeholders, and expected outcomes in one coherent diagram.
prompt.zh: 把这份方案做成一张清晰、可直接用于汇报的可视化图，在一张图里体现关键业务流程、系统组件、数据流、相关方和预期成效。

name.zh: Langhub 企业交付方案说明书.docx

reply.en: Turned the solution brief into a single architecture diagram: request intake from enterprise IM, routing through the Main Agent, core execution in the Agent Runtime, project/task context management, team collaboration, and delivery through external systems and file outputs — with special capabilities called out on the side.
reply.zh: 已把整份方案说明书提炼成一张架构图：从企业 IM 入口接收请求，经 Main Agent 识别与分发，进入 Agent Runtime 核心执行层，配合项目/任务管理与团队协作，最终通过外部系统集成与文件交付产出结果，特色能力单独列在右侧。
